procedure: Deploy only to a protected bounded canary
Keep indexing and sitemap controls OFF
Enable identifier-free TRULOT_PARCEL_SERVER_TIMING only for the bounded observation window
Verify the four Packet 89 APNs plus the 36-case canonical set byte-for-byte
Require every legacy slug to redirect once with no loop
Measure cold and repeated requests with snapshot OFF then ON
Stop and roll back on any canonical mismatch, repeated response above 5000 ms, privacy/robots regression, or source-truth regression
